text:
alex: CI red on master — runtime_serving_tests::kv_cache::ordering_test is failing intermittently on linux runner (2/6 jobs).
ci-bot: build 40213 failed: runtime_serving_tests::kv_cache::ordering_test — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/40213 (junit attached)
mira: on it, can you paste the failure log?
alex: stacktrace shows AssertionError: expected order [A,B,C] got [A,C,B]. looks like reordering during eviction. snippet:
```
AssertionError at kv_cache/tests.rs:214
expected: [A, B, C]
actual:   [A, C, B]
```
no local repro yet.
tj: that smells like a timing window in the async eviction task. the test uses real sleeps (tokio::time::sleep) to wait for background work — flaky by design across runners. we should switch to time::pause + advance.
sam: i can do a rerun/bisect. want me to rerun first or start a bisect immediately?
alex: please rerun first on the flaky runner (runner-3). @ci-bot can you trigger a rerun? :pray:
ci-bot: rerun requested by sam — queued. command: /ci rerun 40213 --parallel=3
eng-runtime-oncall: filing an issue and will watch reruns. if it passes a couple times mark transient, else bisect.
mira: i'll open a quick PR to remove real sleeps and use tokio::time::pause() + advance to make the test deterministic.
alex: also add a deterministic RNG seed in the test harness while you're there.
tj: can you paste the exact test run command? i'll try to repro locally.
alex: run: 
```
cargo test runtime_serving_tests::kv_cache::ordering_test -- --exact --nocapture
```
sam: rerun status: 40213 attempt=1 -> failed again on runner-3. starting bisect 40200..40213 now.
mira: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1842 — replaces sleeps with time::pause in test. passes locally for me on linux-x86.
alex: :thumbsup: can you add a comment in the test explaining the previous flakiness and link to the CI failure?
eng-runtime-oncall: added flaky-tests tag to issue #789 and pinned rerun logs. monitoring.
sam: bisect narrowed it down to commit 40207 (async eviction refactor merge). @tj can you review that commit for missing ordering guarantees?
tj: will take a look today. my hunch: missing fence/await when scheduling eviction callback; will try a small patch and run matrix.
alex: thanks — if the PR fixes it and bisect confirms, merge and backport to adjacent tests. reconvene if CI still red after merge.
